name: Cover image stays with its book after searching by full title
description:
Known defect: covers are bound to grid rows (the site cycles through 4 images by row index).
Steps: remember the cover of every book in the full list -> search several books by full title.
Only books whose cover differs from the first row's cover are searched: a found book
lands in row 1, so a book with the same cover as row 1 would pass even with the defect.
Expected: the found book shows ITS OWN cover.
Actual (defect): it shows the cover of row 1 (README, Findings #13).
Until it is fixed the test is reported as skipped;
when the behaviour is fixed, the test fails to remind that the marker must be removed.

steps.name: Open Book Store
Open page https://demoqa.com/books
$("open") https://demoqa.com/books
$("webdriver") create()
Verify that books table is visible
$("table") should be(visible (because Books table must be visible))
Collect cover image of each displayed book (title -> image src)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img") should have(size(8))
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[0]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[1]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[2]") get attribute(src)

$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[4]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[5]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[6]") get attribute(src)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(8 elements)[7]") get attribute(src)
Search for books by text 'Learning JavaScript Design Patterns' and wait until the filter is applied
Search for a book by its full title
$(".form-control") should be(visible)
$(".form-control") set value(Learning JavaScript Design Patterns)
Verify that each displayed book contains 'Learning JavaScript Design Patterns' and the result is not empty.
$("table tbody tr") should have(all elements to match [each line contains 'Learning JavaScript Design Patterns'] predicate)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
Collect cover image of each displayed book (title -> image src)
$("table tbody tr") should have(size > 0)
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img") should have(size(1))
$("table tbody tr td:nth-child(1) img.snapshot(1 elements)[0]") get attribute(src)
